response.justification: Bogdan is a deeply experienced generalist engineer (15+ years) with strong TypeScript/Node.js, distributed systems, testing craftsmanship, and demonstrated mentoring/teaching ability, all of which map well to the customer-facing, staff-level engineering-excellence side of the role. However, the core requirement — 8+ years building production-grade AI/GenAI solutions — is not met; his AI exposure appears limited to roughly one year at re:cinq on MCP code generators and agentic tooling. The resume shows no Python, no vector databases or RAG architectures, no LLM evaluation/observability work, and only light cloud experience (AWS CDK). He could be a credible candidate for a senior platform/product engineering role adjacent to GenAI, but is a stretch for a Staff Forward Deployed GenAI engineer expected to lead technical discovery and productionize agentic systems for enterprise customers.
strengths: 15+ years shipping production software across web, backend, mobile, and embedded, with staff-level titles
Hands-on MCP server/code-generator and agentic workflow tooling experience — directly relevant emerging skill
Strong teaching, workshop, and conference-speaking track record supporting mentorship and customer-facing duties
concerns: Falls far short of 8+ years building production AI/GenAI solutions (~1 year of relevant exposure)
No evidence of RAG, vector databases, LLM evaluation/optimization, or multi-agent frameworks like LangGraph/CrewAI
Python absent from skills; cloud/data-pipeline depth appears limited to AWS CDK and MongoDB-scale product work

key_factors.factor: Depth of senior/staff engineering and mentorship
